_comment: SAMPLE configuration. Copy to Config/config.json and populate for your environment.
NEVER put a password, API key, client secret or token in this file.
Authentication uses managed identity, IAM roles, or certificate thumbprints -
the thumbprint is a public identifier, the private key stays in the cert store.
config.json must not be committed to source control.

approvals._comment: An approval artifact is created in Pending state. A human moves State to 'Approved' and sets ApprovedBy/ApprovedAt before the gated script will run.

notifications.teamsWebhookUrl: REPLACE-ME (Teams incoming webhook URL) or null
notifications._comment: Send-MailMessage is used for dependency-free delivery on Windows PowerShell 5.1. Prefer Graph mail where available.

itsm._comment: Called with -UseDefaultCredentials. Configure a service account with Kerberos/NTLM access rather than embedding a token.

azure.certificateThumbprint: REPLACE-ME (thumbprint of a cert in CurrentUser\My or LocalMachine\My) or null

aws._comment: Prefer an IAM role or SSO profile. Never an access key pair in this file.

activeDirectory._comment: OU paths are environment-specific and are deliberately not defaulted in scripts.

oci._comment: There is no first-party OCI PowerShell module; these scripts wrap the oci CLI. Authentication comes from the CLI config profile - API keys live in ~/.oci, never here.

vulnerability._comment: Scanner API keys are NEVER stored here. They are passed as SecureString parameters at run time.

protectedComputers: REPLACE-ME (e.g. DC01, DC02 - never act on these)
_comment: protectedProcesses and protectedServices are hard exclusions. Scripts refuse to act on them
and the exclusion cannot be overridden by a parameter - this implements the workbook's
'protected-process blacklist' guardrail for Windows Server use case #6.
restartableServices is the whitelist required by the guardrail on use case #4.

maintenance._comment: Used by change/write scripts that the workbook marks as maintenance-window driven (e.g. Windows Server reboot).
